profileText: a Senator from Kentucky; born in Pittsburgh, Pa., January 7, 1963; attended Baylor University, 1981-1984; graduated Duke University, M.D., 1988; ophthalmologist; elected as a Republican to the United States Senate in 2010; reelected in 2016, and again in 2022 for the term ending January 3, 2029; was an unsuccessful candidate for the Republican presidential nomination in 2016; chair, Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs (One Hundred Nineteenth Congress).
